text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, at the training gym――

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh!! This leg press... won't budge... 
at all...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that spot right there was, just a 
moment ago――

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! That's the spot Dura-san was 
using...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
――Whoa, I had no idea! I'll step aside! 
Wouldn't want to get in your way!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...We take turns on these machines. Not 
that I mind.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No, no! If I tried lifting weights like 
that, I'd be totally exhausted. Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
――Whoa, as expected of Dura-san! I've 
never seen a machine set up like that 
before!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
She comes from an athletic family, so her 
build is just built different. I'm 
completely wiped out... Let's head back to 
the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, even after the other Umamusume 
had left, Duramente pressed on with her 
training...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As it was getting late, I happened to make 
eye contact with Duramente as she moved 
across the gym...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?
choice_data_list:
All on your own, that's some incredible 
focus.

All on your own, that's some incredible 
focus.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Business as usual.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
, I will simply do what I must. ...That is 
all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the heights without looking 
aside— she seems utterly earnest when it 
comes to conditioning and running.
choice_data_list: Feels like we can still keep training.

Even if you're fired up, don't forget to 
cool down.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...It really is getting late. I'll finish 
up with the treadmill and call it a day.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Even indoors, I have to keep my legs 
moving. I don't want to lose my running 
rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ――Farewell.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I stayed to watch until the 
very end as Duramente methodically worked 
her legs in the gym.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
A workout is only complete once aftercare 
is done. I won't cut corners.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Duramente methodically 
worked through her regimen, carrying it 
out flawlessly right down to the final 
stretch.
